name: Look out! Crazy drivers.
author: CookieDoughDev
description:
Challenge a friend with a race to the end of the road, but keep an eye out for the crazy drivers!

Here is my spin on the first prototype project from the Create with Code series! I added camera switching, a bunch of stacked obstacles, some oncoming cars that can steer left and right to make it harder to dodge, and lastly local multiplayer for that competitive goodness!

Hope you enjoy it!


The Controls:
    Player 1:
	WASD - To drive forward, backwards, steer left and right.
	Left control or E - To toggle the camera to the driver seat.
    Player 2:
	Arrow keys - To drive forward, backwards, steer left and right.
	Right control - To toggle the camera to the driver seat.

Primitive objects used, are from the Create with Code series - https://learn.unity.com/tutorial/set-up-your-first-project-in-unity?uv=2020.3&courseId=5cf96c41edbc2a2ca6e8810f&projectId=5caccdfbedbc2a3cef0efe63
